name: valkey
description_en: A flexible distributed key-value database that is optimized for caching and other realtime workloads.
readme_excerpt: This project was forked from the open source Redis project right before the transition to their new source available licenses. This README is just a fast quick start document. More details can be found under valkey.io What is Valkey? Valkey is a high-performance data structure server that primarily serves key/value workloads.
